subtext: Oasis Women Center is opening a transitional home for women who have completed a recovery program and are ready to successfully transition into sustainable, independent living.

stats.label: Monthly fee per resident, far below market price

milestones.title: 501(c)(3) status secured
milestones.detail: Recognized by the IRS. Gifts are tax deductible.

milestones.title: Board seated, bylaws adopted
milestones.detail: Governance and conflict of interest policy in place.

milestones.title: Program designed in full
milestones.detail: Four pillars, intake criteria, and service plans documented.

milestones.title: Funding the lease or purchasing a home
milestones.detail: Where we are now. This is what your gift pays for.

milestones.title: Programs started
milestones.detail: Financial education, job skills, and career building.

disclosure: We are pre-house. No woman has moved in yet, and we will not pretend otherwise. What exists today is 501(c)(3) status, a seated board, a program designed in detail, and a community starting to fund it. The house is the next step, and it is the step your gift pays for.
